content: 1. The information collected must have practical utility. 2. The accuracy of the FDA's estimate regarding the burden of the proposed information collection must be evaluated, including the validity of the methodology and assumptions used in the process. 3. Efforts should be made to enhance the quality, utility, and clarity of the information being collected. 4. Strategies should be identified to minimize the burden of information collection on respondents, including the use of automated collection techniques and other forms of information technology, where appropriate. Under section 379j-12 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, the FDA has the authority to assess and collect certain animal drug user fees. The submission of these user fees is required concurrently with the submission of applications and supplements. Consequently, the review of an application cannot commence until the associated fee has been submitted. According to the new statutory provisions (section 740(e) of the Act, as amended by the Animal Drug User Fee Amendments [ADUFA]), any animal drug applications or supplemental animal drug applications for which the required fee has not been paid are considered incomplete. Such applications will not be accepted for review by the FDA. Certain types of fees, including those for specific animal drug applications and supplemental animal drug applications, require the submission of a cover sheet. The cover sheet, known as FDA Form 3546, is designed to provide the minimum necessary information to determine whether a fee is required for the review of an application or supplement, to calculate the amount of the required fee, and to ensure that each animal drug user fee payment is appropriately linked to the corresponding application or supplement. When completed electronically, the form generates a unique payment identification number, which is used to track the payment. The FDA will utilize the information collected through this process to initiate administrative screening of new animal drug applications and supplements, ensuring that the required payment has been received.
